opt_hint: The free Open-Meteo endpoint is intended for non-commercial use per its terms. For commercial or self-hosted use, set your own base URL (and key if required).
proc_alg_help: Fetches the weather from Open-Meteo for every point of a point layer and writes the results into a new point layer (same fields as the click tool's collection layer). A failed fetch does not abort the run - it is counted and reported at the end. Optionally renders a chart (PNG) per point and produces a second output layer with one row per point and hour, for temporal animation in the Temporal Controller.
proc_err_chart: Point {i}: chart could not be created: {msg}
proc_err_crs: Invalid input layer CRS - coordinates are used unchecked as WGS84 degrees.
proc_param_places_help: Reverse geocoding via Nominatim costs about 1.1 seconds per point (minimum spacing required by the usage policy) - roughly four minutes of extra runtime for 200 points. Off by default.
save_as_tif_load: Save as GeoTIFF and load into the map …
save_err_gdal: GeoTIFF needs the GDAL bindings of QGIS (module osgeo), which are missing here: {msg}. PNG, SVG, PDF and CSV still work.
